deviations.what: sap.m.plugins.CellSelector is @since 1.119 and sap.m.plugins.CopyProvider is @since 1.110 (its visible property @since 1.114) - all newer than the 1.71 floor. The CellSelector is kept, so the port is filed under src/02.

The CopyProvider is DROPPED. Its extractData is a JavaScript callback that reads each column's app:bindings CustomData and formats it with app:template, and the control REFUSES to be created without one ('extractData property must be defined for Element sap.m.plugins.CopyProvider') - so it is not a matter of copying in a default format, the plugin takes the whole view down. abap2UI5 cannot register such a callback, so the dependents aggregation keeps only the CellSelector and the cell copy is lost (structural-diff reports the CopyProvider element and its extractData as missing). The app: CustomData attributes stay on the four columns 1:1, so nothing about the sample's data description is lost.

onVisibleChange / onEnabledChange / onSparseChange call three setters on the CopyProvider. The three CheckBoxes are two-way bound to three flags here instead, so the three CheckBox.select attributes are dropped; with the plugin gone the flags drive nothing, but the toolbar the sample shows is unchanged. The copy BUTTON the controller takes from the plugin and adds to the toolbar goes with it.
The CellSelector and the three CheckBoxes are unverified in a running system. **e2e-verified 2026-08-25** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_523.mjs).

property_gate.reason: The '\n' in the app:template CustomData on the ProductId/Name column is a 1:1 copy of the sample and reaches nobody. escape-sequence-in-backtick is scoped to text that REACHES THE USER, and this value is neither rendered nor read: app:template is CustomData for sap.m.plugins.CopyProvider's extractData callback, and the IMPROVISED deviation above records that the CopyProvider is DROPPED (abap2UI5 cannot register a JS callback, and the control refuses to be created without one). The four app: attributes stay on the columns precisely so the sample's data description is not lost - that is the deviation's own words - so the string is documentation of the original, not a template anything expands. Rewriting it as `\{1\}` && |\n| && `\{0\}` would be worse on both counts: it drops the 1:1 value the deviation promises, and an XML attribute normalises a literal #xA to a space on parse anyway, so the line break would not survive into the CustomData either. The skip covers that one finding type, and view-gates fails this port if it stops firing - which is what restoring a real CopyProvider would have to do.
